entitycounter.hud.title: Entity Counter
entitycounter.config.title: Entity Counter Settings
entitycounter.config.highlight.desc: Marks the counted block with a glowing green box.
entitycounter.mode.auto.desc: Sees through glass and picks the first block that contains entities.
entitycounter.mode.looked_at.desc: Exactly the block under your crosshair.
entitycounter.mode.in_front.desc: The block in front of the one you look at.
entitycounter.mode.behind.desc: The block directly behind the one you look at.
entitycounter.config.coordinates.desc: Shows the position of the counted block in the panel.
entitycounter.config.position.desc: Drag the panel to any spot on the screen.
entitycounter.position.title: Move the display
entitycounter.position.hint: Drag the panel to where you want it
entitycounter.tutorial.description: Shows how many entities stand in the block you look at.
entitycounter.tutorial.count.title: Count what is in a block
entitycounter.tutorial.count.text: Press %s and look at a block. The panel lists every entity in it with picture, name and count, and the counted block glows green.
entitycounter.tutorial.modes.title: Choose which block is counted
entitycounter.tutorial.modes.text: Automatic sees through glass into closed chambers. You can also count exactly the block you look at, the one in front of it or the one behind it. Pick the mode in the settings under "Counted block".
entitycounter.tutorial.settings.title: Make it yours
entitycounter.tutorial.settings.text: Switch the mode, turn the green highlight off or drag the display to another spot. Open the settings through Mod Menu, or bind a key under Controls > Entity Counter.
entitycounter.config.tutorial.desc: Shows the quick tour of this mod again.
entitycounter.news.1_4_0.folder: Settings now live in config/KCMods/entitycounter/. Your old settings are moved there automatically.
entitycounter.news.1_4_0.news: After an update, a short "What's new" like this one appears once.
entitycounter.news.1_3_1.debug: The display stays visible with always-on debug entries like chunk borders (F3+F6). Only the full F3 screen hides it.
entitycounter.news.1_3_1.menu: The tour also appears on clients with their own main menu, like NoRisk.
entitycounter.news.1_4_1.items: Dropped items of the same kind but different contents are counted separately - e.g. a Potion of Swiftness and a Potion of Healing.
entitycounter.news.1_4_1.vehicle: Your own boat or minecart is no longer counted while you ride it.
entitycounter.news.1_4_1.position: A display position edited by hand in the config file is kept on screen.
